west_mouldings.name: upper cornice below the south cap

known_limits: North extreme has no independent endwall confirmation. N1 is 0.84–2.79 m outside the dated model polygon but the same three north double bays continue in two station photographs. Retain measured frontage-specific section cuts. South end lower row beyond the first opening is masked by trees and boundary walls. Upper end extends through three visible bays. Roof behind parapet is not established by these views.

section_vacancies.reason: Eight original photographs and four more winter stations do not distinguish the right opening behind the switch cabinet and tree. Cut this portion only; the left aperture is independently visible in February 2020.

north_upper_render: Two independent west photographs show plain lime render at X−15.0 to −13.28 and −10.32 to −9.68, about Z12.6. The short tile at X−8.254 to −7.944 is visible at Z12.55. Continue the plain construction course where cut, leaving concealed right N3 open.
